name: @local/dsh-oks
description: A Harness capability, not a wrapper for one model: whatever knowledge service (OKS) and data file a session's workspace declares in oks.json become six native tools — search / references / vocabulary / info / check_intent / query — turning a business question into rows read from that data file over a read-only connection. Search finds the keys of the vocabulary by name or description, references walks the reference graph backwards, the vocabulary pager hands the whole vocabulary to a vocabulary helper in a fixed order, and oks_info reads any node from the opaque key "index". va_ask consults a vocabulary helper the plugin owns (a top-level agent on the same preset and workspace, sharing the process-wide index, archived while idle): the plugin prepares it in three steps (role and reading order, working method, then a warm-up question that becomes the rewind marker) and after every answer collapses the question-and-answer after that marker, so between questions the helper sees only vocabulary, method and the current question, while the session log stays append-only.
